gate1_performance.assessment: FAIL - SR 0.646 well below 1.0 threshold. CAGR 6.75% far below 16% target. IR negative = underperforms benchmark on risk-adjusted basis. MDD 23.89% is acceptable. DD brake reduced MDD from 31.77% (base) to 23.89% but at severe CAGR cost (7.98% -> 6.75%).

gate2_artifacts.assessment: All stage artifacts present (S0-S4). Charts generated.

gate3_role_honesty.assessment: MIXED - S3 hints diversifier (factor_mean_max_corr=0.943 = highly redundant), S4 claims core_alpha. Given SR 0.646 and negative IR, diversifier is more honest. The S4 core_alpha classification appears optimistic -- strategy does not generate sufficient independent alpha for core status. Judge overrides to DIVERSIFIER (weak).

gate4_statistical.assessment: FAIL - OOS retention 35.3% (IS SR 0.785 -> OOS 0.277) indicates significant overfitting or alpha decay. Alpha trend ratio 0.70 (recent 3Y SR 0.452 vs full 0.646) shows decaying alpha. Strong stress performance (3/3) and rolling consistency (87%) partially offset but insufficient.

gate5_ff5.assessment: FF5 not run for this S5 mutation variant. Base strategy (output/) has no FF5 result either. Cannot verify factor-adjusted alpha.

s3_orthogonality_review.assessment: POOR - Factor correlation 0.943 indicates CR08 and D01 are near-redundant in this blend. Return correlation 0.829 with existing strategies = high overlap. Novelty 0.324 is low. This strategy does not add meaningful diversification to the portfolio.

mutation_assessment.assessment: M2 (DD 5/15) is the best mutation by SR (0.646 vs M1 0.566, M3 0.598) and achieves acceptable MDD (23.89%). However, the aggressive DD brake (start at 5% drawdown) clips too much upside -- CAGR drops from 7.98% to 6.75%. The Calmar ratio (0.283) remains poor. None of the mutations achieve meaningful improvement over the weak base signal.

overall_verdict.summary: STR_1422_s5_m2 is PIT-clean but fundamentally weak. The CR08+D01 crowding-defense blend produces a mediocre signal (base SR 0.633, CAGR 7.98%) with high factor redundancy (corr 0.943). The DD 5/15 aggressive brake successfully reduces MDD from 31.77% to 23.89% but sacrifices too much return (CAGR 6.75%). OOS degradation (35% retention) and alpha decay (ratio 0.70) suggest the limited alpha is not robust. Negative IR means KOSPI outperforms on a risk-adjusted basis. The crowding concept (CR08 Volume-Price Divergence) has theoretical merit per Lou & Polk (2022) but the implementation does not extract sufficient alpha in the Korean market, likely because CR08's ICIR of 0.498 does not survive the 2-factor blend with D01.
